name: Hiiragi Natsuki
source:
Her name sounds the same as [url=/c1344]Natsuki[/url]'s but has a different meaning. She is [url=/c1345]Hinata[/url]'s younger twin-sister and a famous novelist. Likes to tease people by pretending to be [url=/c1345]Hinata[/url]. She is firmly and surprisingly mischievous. 

Sometimes feel dizzy so she drinks a lot of coffee.

[Edited from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=31461]Getchu[/url]]
